di: dar — I gave (strong preterite 1st sg.; non gelas di yo 'I did not give them (to them)'; = di)
ferrando: Ferrando — Fernando (Fernando González, the other infante of Carrión; = Fernando)
otorga: otorgar — he confirms, bears out; grants, consents (present 3rd sg.; assi lo otorga don Pero 'so Don Pero confirms it', of Fernando's claim; = otorga, confirma)
razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación) · also razón — 'word, voice' (en una razón 'with one voice, in agreement'; = razón) · also razón — fecha por razón 'made with good reason, with purpose' (the cap fitted for a purpose); also dezir mi razón 'state my case' · also razón — 'right, fitting, reasonable' (tod esto es razón 'all this is right'; = razón); acordar la razón 'to agree on what to answer' (acuerdan la razón 'they agree on their answer', Pidal 'convienen la respuesta') · also dar razón de — 'to give an account of, answer for' (dedes dello razón 'give an account of it')
te: te — you, thee (2nd sg. object pronoun) · also te — reflexive 'yourself' (non te juntarás 'you will not join yourself, come up with'; = te)
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia) · also Valençia — the city itself, held by the Cid (en Valençia sedí mio Çid 'in Valencia was my Cid'; Valençia vienen çercar 'they come to besiege Valencia')
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
león: León — León, the kingdom and city (Alfons el de León 'Alfonso of León'; = León) · also león — lion, the animal (masc.; saliós … el león 'the lion broke loose', adeliñó para' león 'he made straight for the lion'; = león), not the kingdom
durmie: dormir — he was sleeping (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending; = dormía)
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself') · also se — dative 'to him, to them' before lo (= le, old gelo; ca él se lo mandó 'for he had ordered it (of them)', Pidal queries the half-line) · also se — in a split future, partir se a 'will break up, be dissolved' (partir se a la cort 'the court will break up'; partir + se + a (= ha); = se partirá, se disolverá)
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it') · also e — pleonastic 'and' joining two names of the one person (a Dios e al padre 'to God, the Father'; Pidal 'conjunción e pleonástica', cf. v. 300)
tú: tú — thou, you (2nd sg. subject pronoun; used in prayer to God)
qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also qué — how (exclamative before an adverb: qué bien pago 'how well he paid')
con: con — with · also con — 'with the help of' (con Dios 'with God's help'; verlo hemos con Dios 'we shall see it with God's help') · also con — 'up to, as high as' (las ramas pujan con las nuoves 'the branches climb up to the clouds', Pidal 'suben hasta las nubes')
tras: tras — after, behind (preposition; tras mio Çid 'after the Cid, in pursuit of'; = tras)
escaño: escaño — bench, long seat with a back (masc. sg.; = escaño)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment') · also de — 'with, from' of the means or source (diziendo de la boca 'saying with his mouth'; de cuer les pesa 'it grieves them from the heart') · also de que 'of whom, of which' (relative after a noun; de moros de que non avien sabor 'of Moors they had no taste for') · de firme 'steadfastly, with a will' (de firme robavan el campo); de + noun of material, 'in' (de plata seys çientos marcos 'six hundred marks in silver'); of possession, 'belonging to' (de vos son 'are yours'); fartos de lidiar 'sated with fighting'; pagado de 'pleased with' · also de — dé, may he give (present subjunctive 3rd sg. of dar, printed without accent; que vos de dent buen galardón 'that he may give you a good reward for it'; = dé) · also tanto … de + adjective, 'so (very)' (tanto son de traspuestas 'so far gone are they')
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings') · also por — 'in requital for, to avenge' (nos vengaremos aquesta por la del león 'we shall avenge this one for the lion affair'); por muertas 'for dead, as dead'; por lo que 'for what, on account of what'
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away') · also o — then, opening a question that follows from what precedes (¿o quien gelas diera …? Pidal '¿quién, pues, …?')
menos: menos — least, less · menos fallar — to find missing, to miss (de los sos menos non fallaron 'of their own men they missed no more than fifteen') · also a menos de — 'without, short of' (a menos de batalla non pueden den quitar 'short of a battle they cannot get clear of it')
nós: nós — we (stressed subject pronoun; con Dios nós guisaremos 'with God we shall arrange it'; = nosotros)
fasta: fasta — until, as far as (= hasta)
do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain) · also dar — I give (present 1st sg.; d'aquí vos do mi graçia 'from here I give you my favor'; = doy) · also do — for don, 'lord' (title before a name; el obispo do Jero[me] 'the bishop don Jerome')
despertó: despertar — he woke up (preterite 3rd sg.; = despertó)
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué) · also que — how, exclamative before an adverb (Dios, que bien los sirvió! 'God, how well he served them!'; = qué) · also que — something, what, after aver + infinitive (abrien que ve[er] 'they would have something to see'; = que) · also de que — 'since, from the time that' (de que fu rey 'since I was king'; = desde que)
gañó: gañar — he won, captured (preterite 3rd sg.; = ganó)
levantós: levantar + se — he rose (preterite levantó + enclitic -s(e); levantós el rey 'the king rose'; = se levantó)
poral: pora + el — toward the (pora 'toward, for' + article; Pidal restores the a: por[a]l castiello 'toward the castle'; = para el, hacia el)
premió: premer — it pressed down, lowered (preterite 3rd sg.; la cabeça premió, Pidal 'bajó la cabeza'; Latin premere; closest apretar, bajar; not modern premiar 'to reward')
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
cabeça: cabeça — head (= cabeza; ç sounded ts)
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con) · also prender a espolonada — 'to begin the attack, charge' (priso a espolonada, Pidal 'comenzó el ataque'); pendón a corças 'a banner with (a device of) roe-does' (a = 'with', likely) · also a — = ha, the ending of a split future after infinitive + pronoun (quitar me a 'he will quit … on me', partir se a la cort 'the court will break up'; = -á)
prender: prender — to seize, arrest (infinitive; = prender) · also prender — to take, accept (prender so don 'to take his gift'; = tomar, aceptar)
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
cuello: cuello — neck (= cuello; al cuello 'about his neck' of a mantle worn, and 'by the neck', al cuello lo tomó, Pidal 'lo cogió por el cuello')
red: red — grating, cage (fem. noun; Pidal 'reja, jaula'; here the lion's cage; modern red 'net')
le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him') · also le — dative of separation, 'from him' (que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'); dative 'for him' (ques le non spidiés 'who does not take leave of him')
metió: meter — he put (preterite 3rd sg.; metió mano 'laid hand to'; = metió) · also meterse — he went into, hid himself (en un monte espesso … se metió 'he went into a thick wood'); dentro las metió 'he brought them inside'
tornó: tornar — he turned (preterite 3rd sg.) · also tornar — he went back, returned (el otro tornó a Albar Fáñez 'the other went back to Minaya')
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
víolos: ver + los — he saw them (preterite 3rd sg. vío + enclitic los; Víolos venir 'he saw them coming'; = los vio)
aderredor: aderredor — around, round about (adverb, a- + derredor; que andan aderredor 'that range around'; = alrededor)
demandó: demandar — he asked for, inquired after (preterite 3rd sg.; demandó por Alfonsso 'he asked for Alfonso'; = preguntó por)
falló: fallar — he found (preterite 3rd sg.; quando los falló 'when he had found them (all assembled)'; = halló)
cuerpo: cuerpo — body (= cuerpo; perder el cuerpo 'to lose one's life')
malo: malo — bad; un dinero malo, 'one bad penny' — a debased coin, naming the smallest thing worth mentioning
aquí: aquí — here; d'aquí 'from here' · also 'then, at this point' (aquí dixo el comde 'then the count said')
ante: ante — before; ante que 'before (that)' · also ante — because of, at (of the cause, like Latin prae; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums')
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied') · also don — when, where (= donde, of time; Don llegan los otros 'when the others come up')
elvira: Elvira — Elvira, one of the Cid's two daughters (doña Elvira, also printed don Elvira; = Elvira)
doña: doña — lady (title; Latin domina, fem. of don)
sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — so + l, 'under the' (so 'under', Latin sub, + el before a vowel): del sol espada 'from under the sword' (the likeliest reading; the construction is uncertain) · also Sol — doña Sol, one of the Cid's two daughters (personal name) · also sol — so + el, 'under the' (metiós sol esçaño 'he got under the bench'; here the sense is clear)
quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar) · tanto quanto 'as long as'; por quanto … ha 'for all that there is' (por quanto en el mundo ha) · also en quanto — 'as far as, insofar as' (En quanto podemos 'as far as we are able'; = en cuanto)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
dexastes: dexar — you left (preterite 2nd pl.; solas las dexastes 'you left them alone'; = dejasteis)
valedes: valer — you are worth (present 2nd pl.; más valedes que nos 'you are worth more than we'; = valéis) · also menos valedes — you are worth less, the legal charge of menos valer, lost honour (Pidal 'incurrís en infamia')
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you') · also vos — stressed 'you' after a preposition (parto de vos 'I part from you'; abiltaredes a vos 'you will dishonor yourselves')
ellas: ella — they, them (fem. pl., stressed; con ellas 'with them'; = ellas)
son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
varones: varón — man, male · also varón — man of rank, lord, baron (pl.; varones castellanos 'Castilian lords'; = varones, nobles)
guisas: guisa — manner, way (pl.; en todas guisas 'in every way'; = guisas, modo)
más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more' · also más por espacio — 'later, at more leisure' (más 'further'; por espacio 'in good time')
valen: valer — they are worth (present 3rd pl.; averes que valen grant valor 'goods of great worth'; = valen)
fore: seer — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg. of ser; = fuere)
lid: lid — battle, fight (fem. noun; lid campal 'pitched battle'; vençiemos la lid 'we won the battle'; = lid, now literary, closest batalla, combate)
si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda) · also si non — 'except, but for' (si non a estos cavalleros 'except these knights'; = salvo) · also si — 'so', optative, = sí, with the present subjunctive in an adjuration (si vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you') · also si — heading a direct question, as if it were indirect (si me los dades 'will you give them to me?'; Pidal, note to 1922: 'La conjunción si encabeza una interrogación directa'; = ¿…?)
ploguiere: plazer — (as long as) it may please (future subjunctive 3rd sg., strong; mientra ploguiere al Padre 'as long as it please the Father'; si vos ploguiere 'if it please you'; = pluguiere)
guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of' · a vuestra guisa 'as you see fit, in your own way' (prended a vuestra guisa 'take as you please') · also de guisa que 'in such a way that' (de guisa irán por ellas que … 'in such a manner will they go for them that …'; = de modo que) · also a fea guisa 'in a shameful fashion' (sácanlos de las huertas mucho a fea guisa 'they drive them out most shamefully')
traydor: traidor — traitor (= traidor, old spelling traydor)
he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he) · also he — and (a spelling of e; he de fijas de mio Çid 'and of the daughters of my Çid')
dicho: dezir — said (past part.; a dicho = ha dicho, 'he has said')
seré: seer — I shall be (future 1st sg. of ser)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
aquestos: aqueste — these (masc. pl., 'aqueste' = este with prefixed aque-; aquestos dos reyes 'these two kings'; = estos)
díag: Díag — Diego (Pidal's Dí[a]g Téllez, with the restored a; = Diego)
gonçálvez: Gonçálvez — González, patronymic 'son of Gonçalo' (Gonçál[v]ez, the v supplied; here Asur González; = González) · also of Ferrand Gonçálvez, Fernando González, one of the Infantes of Carrión
odredes: oír — you will hear (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = oiréis; the minstrel's aside to his listeners)
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
natura: natura — birth, lineage (de grand natura 'of high birth'; = linaje, naturaleza)
somos: seer — we are (1st pl. of seer = ser)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
comdes: conde — counts (pl., Pidal's co[m]des; de comdes de Carrión 'of the counts of Carrión'; = condes)
rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
porque: por que — because, in that (causal, written as one word; derecho fizieron porque las han dexadas 'they did right because they have left them'; = porque)
dexamos: dexar — we left (preterite 1st pl., the same form as the present; por que las dexamos 'in that we left them'; = dejamos)
aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day') · also 'even though' (= aunque; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia, Pidal's reading)
no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison) · also nos — stressed 'us' after a preposition (daxadas seredes de nos 'you will be abandoned by us'; sobre nos 'upon us'); stressed repeated subject (mártires seremos nos 'we shall be martyrs') · also nos — each other, reciprocal (saludar nos hemos 'we shall greet each other')
mientra: mientra — while, as long as (= mientras)
aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have') · also aver — to have (infinitive; aver … de + inf. 'to be bound to', split conditional aver vos lo iedes de far 'you would be bound to do it') · also aver as the first half of a split conditional (aver la yemos 'we would have it'; = la habríamos)
les: les — to them · also les — 'from them', dative of removal or injury (les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; viédales exir 'forbids them to go out')
fiziemos: fazer — we did (preterite 1st pl.; derecho fiziemos nos 'we did right'; = hicimos)
seer: seer — to sit (infinitive, Latin sedere; sabor … de seer e de comer 'pleasure in sitting and eating'); also the infinitive of ser 'to be' (= sentarse, estar sentado; ser)
ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien) · also ha — of time elapsed, 'it is, it has been' (Pocos días ha … que 'it is a few days since'; = hace)
tod: todo — all, the whole (apocopated before a vowel)
ondrados: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. masc. pl.; = honrados)
venidos: venir — come, become (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; ricos son venidos 'have become rich'; = venidos)
martín: Martín (Antolínez) — a knight of Burgos, companion of the Cid, who provisions him on his exile and negotiates the loan from Raquel and Vidas · also río Martín — the river Martín, in Aragon (el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín'; = río Martín)
antolínez: Antolínez — surname of Martín Antolínez, the Burgalese knight who aids the Cid
fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned') · also fo — went (ir; mañanas fo Minaya 'in the morning Minaya went'); fo de moros 'it came from the Moors' (ser de + noun of origin; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — it was, ser + adjective predicate (Buena fo la de Valençia 'good was the (capture) of Valencia'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — was (the man) of, belonged to (ser de of a vassal; el que de Albar Fáñez fo 'he who was Álvar Fáñez's man'; = fue) · also en estas nuevas fo 'was in on these doings, took part' (ser en 'to be involved in'); fo padre 'was the father' (ser + noun predicate)
levantar: levantar — to rise, to get up (infinitive; Nos quiso levantar 'he would not rise', the reflexive se carried in Nos = non + se; = levantarse)
boca: boca — mouth (besóle la boca 'he kissed his mouth'; = boca)
sin: sin — without · also sin — 'besides, apart from' (sin las peonadas 'besides the foot-soldiers'); sin falla 'without fail'; sin dubda
verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad) · also non será verdad — 'it shall not be so' (Pidal: 'esto no será así'; esto non será verdad) · also por verdad — truly, indeed (í albergaron por verdad una noch 'they truly lodged there one night')
deve: dever — he ought, must (present 3rd sg.; tal deve sperar 'such he must expect'; = debe)
olbidar: olbidar — to forget (infinitive, spelt with b for v; no lo quiera olbidar 'let him not forget'; = olvidar)
meter: meter — to put, set (infinitive; vo meter la vuestra seña 'I go to put your banner'; = meter)
viga: viga — beam, timber (fem. noun; viga lagar 'the beam of a press', the two nouns in apposition; = viga)
lagar: lagar — wine or oil press, press-house (masc. noun; = lagar); in viga lagar the pair is read as 'press-beam', reading from context
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
brial: brial — tunic, long silk garment worn by nobles (masc. noun; no modern word in use, closest túnica)
passará: passar — it will pass (future 3rd sg.; non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'; = pasará)
sabed: saber — know, take note of (imperative 2nd pl.; e vos sabed el mensage 'and you, learn the message'; = sabed)
partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part') · also 'to divide, apportion' (partir tod aqueste aver 'to divide all this wealth') · also partir (se) — 'to break up, be dissolved' (of an assembly; split future partir se a la cort 'the court will be dissolved'; = disolverse, partirse)
has: aver — you have (present 2nd sg.; perfect auxiliary, de quanto dicho has 'of all you have said'; = has)
destos: de + estos — of these (contraction; en cada uno destos años 'in each one of these years'; = de estos)
ansuor: Ansuor — Asur (Pidal's form; A[n]su[o]r with letters supplied), Asur González, elder brother of the Infantes of Carrión (Pidal; = Asur)
gonçalvez: Gonçalvez — González, 'son of Gonçalvo' (patronymic; Ferrant Gonçalvez, Diag Gonçalvez; = González)
entrava: entrar — he was entering (imperfect 3rd sg.) · also entrava — 'he entered', narrative imperfect (En las azes primeras … entrava 'into the foremost ranks he rode')
palaçio: palaçio — hall, palace; the main room of a house (= palacio)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message')
era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
fabló: fablar — he spoke (preterite; = habló, note f-)
avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié) · also aver — impersonal temporal 'it had been' (passado avie tres años 'three years had passed'; = hacía/habían pasado) · also avie — impersonal 'there was' (non avie recabdo 'there was no reckoning'; = había)
poco: poco — little · also a poco que — 'shortly after' (a poco que viniestes 'a little after you came')
recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está) · also non avie recabdo — there was no counting or reckoning (de los colpes de las lanças non avie recabdo 'the lance blows could not be reckoned'; sense uncertain, from the 'account, reckoning' sense; Pidal gives no note here) · also recabdo — answer, reply, heed (el una al otra nol torna recabdo 'neither gives the other heed or answer'; sense taken from context, Pidal gives no note)
ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
quien: quien — who, whom (relative pronoun, also with a plural antecedent; = quien, quienes) · also quien — 'whoever, he who' (quien quiere perder cueta 'whoever wishes to lose distress'); interrogative 'who?' (¿quien vos lo podrie contar? 'who could tell it you?'; = quién)
vido: veer — he saw (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal's vi[d]o; = vio)
tal: tal — such; por tal 'for such a reason, for this purpose' (= tal) · also tal … commo — 'such … as' (tal juego commo iva por la cort 'such sport as went round the court') · also tal … que — 'such … that' of result (tal cosa vos faría que por el mundo sonás 'I would do you such a thing that it would resound through the world')
mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart') · also tener a mal — 'to take amiss' (non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it amiss') · also mal — evil, bad (adjective, apocopated malo, before a noun; mal galardón 'an evil reward'; = mal) · also Mal Anda — a man's name (see anda)
quién: quién — whom, who (interrogative/relative; a quién sirvieron tanto 'whom they served so well'; = quién)
nuevas: nueva — news, tidings (fem. pl.; sus nuevas legavan 'his news was arriving'; = noticias, nuevas) · also nuevas — renown, fame (las nuevas de mio Çid sonando van; Pidal 'renombre, fama') · also nuevas — affairs, doings (las nuevas del cavallero 'the knight's affairs'; Pidal 'los asuntos, los negocios') · also nuevas — exploits, deeds (las nuevas que faze el Campeador; Pidal 'las hazañas que hace') · also grandes son las nuevas 'there is a great stir' (Pidal 'gran actividad o animación hay')
bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form) · also ir — he should go (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., the preterite stem of seer shared with ir; que f[o]sse con Minaya 'that he should go with Minaya'; = fuese) · also seer — I were (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg.; commo si fosse delant 'as if I were present')
rio: río — river; Rio d'amor, a place Pidal says is unknown today, which must have lain east of San Esteban de Gormaz (= río)
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out') · also commo — 'as soon as, when' (commo gelo a dicho 'as soon as he told it him'); 'since, as' (commo fío por Dios 'as I trust in God')
far: far — to do (apocopated infinitive of fazer; = hacer)
carrión: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia, seat of the counts of Carrión (= Carrión)
casar: casar — to marry off, to be married (infinitive; por casar son vuestras fijas 'your daughters are to be married'; por + inf. 'still to be done'; = casar) · also casar — to marry (infinitive, active, of the suitors; casar queremos con ellas 'we wish to marry them'; = casar)
essora: essora — then, at that moment (ess' + ora; en essora 'at that moment'; = entonces)
muño: Muño — personal name (Muño Gustioz, a vassal of the Cid; = Munio, an old name; Nuño is probably related)
gustioz: Gustioz — patronymic 'son of Gustio' (Muño Gustioz, the Cid's retainer, brought up in his household; = Gustioz, no modern form)
levantó: levantar — he raised, got up (preterite 3rd sg.; with reflexive se, se levantó 'he stood up'; = levantó)
antes: antes — before; antes de 'before' · also antes que — 'before' (conjunction; antes quel prendan 'before they take him') · also antes — 'rather' (antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body')
vayas: ir — you go, may you go (present subjunctive 2nd sg.; mándot que vayas 'I bid you go'; = vayas)
das: dar — you give (present 2nd sg.; si non das consejo 'if you do not give counsel'; = das)
paz: paz — peace (= paz; moros en paz 'Moors at peace', i.e. those who have submitted)
dizes: dezir — you say (present 2nd sg.; verdad dizes 'you speak the truth'; = dices)
ni: ni — nor, not even (continues the negative; non fo a nuestro grado ni nos non pudiemos mas 'it was not to our liking, nor could we do otherwise'; = ni)
raçión: raçión — share, portion (fem. noun; non ayan i raçión, Pidal 'no tomen parte en la batalla'; closest parte; not the modern 'ration') · a la raçión — to each share (a la raçión cadie 'to each share fell'; Pidal: the booty was divided into raciones, afterwards shared out in proportion among the fighters)
fazer: fazer — to make, do, dig (infinitive; mandó fazer 'ordered made'; = hacer)
qual: qual — which (relative/interrogative adjective; de qual part 'from whichever side'; = cual)
digo: dezir — I say (present 1st sg.; yo non vos digo nada 'I say nothing to you'; = digo)
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do' · also future auxiliary after an infinitive, the split future (ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán)
sín: sí + me (?) — so … me (the optative sí, as in sí el Criador vos salve, with an enclitic pronoun, most likely me written n; sín salve el Criador 'so may the Creator save me'; Pidal gives no note and the reading is uncertain; = así me salve el Creador) · also sín salve Dios 'so may God save me' (Pidal paraphrases the oath 'así me salve Dios', which supports the reading sí + me)
salve: salvar — may he save (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; sí el Criador vos salve 'so may the Creator save you'; = salve)
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
assí: assí — thus, so (= así) · also assí — so greatly, so much (Pidal 'de tal modo, mucho'; assí envergonçó 'was so abashed') · also assí commo 'as soon as' (Assí commo descavalga 'as soon as he dismounts'; = así como, en cuanto) · also assí … commo — 'as many … as' (assí parientes commo son, Pidal 'tantos parientes cuantos son', 'todos ellos', all the kinsmen there are) · also assí — just as, according as (assí commo lo ha dicho 'just as he has said it'; = tal como)
affé: affé — behold, here is/are (presentative; affé amas mis fijas 'behold both my daughters'; cf. afé; origin uncertain; = he aquí)
dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran) · also do + se, 'where … (he might)' with a subjunctive (non vido … dos alçasse 'he saw nowhere he might hide', Pidal 'donde se escondiese')
cort: cort — court, royal or lordly household (fem. noun; en mi cort 'in my court'; = corte) · also cort — a court summoned as a solemn assembly for judgement (pregonarán mi[e] cort 'they will proclaim my court'; Pidal, note to 2963, the corte pregonada o solemne; = cortes)
uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one' · el uno ... el otro 'the one ... the other' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró) · also lo uno … lo otro 'one part … the other part' (neuter; lo uno adebdan e lo otro pagavan 'part they owe and part they paid')
dizen: dezir — they say, they call (present 3rd pl.; do dizen monte Calvarie 'where they call (it) Mount Calvary'; = dicen)
otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro) · also otro día 'the next day'; lo otro 'the rest' · also otro tanto 'just as much, likewise' (Pidal calls the line difficult: e Per Vermudoz otro tanto las ha 'and Per Vermudoz as much (said) to them')
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place') · also es a + infinitive 'is to be done, must be done' (impersonal; Ya lo vidieron que es a fer 'they saw that it had to be done'; = hay que hacer)
navarra: Navarra — Navarre (por Aragón e por Navarra 'through Aragon and Navarre'; = Navarra)
aragón: Aragón — Aragon, the kingdom/region east of Castile (el bueno de Aragón 'the good (man) from Aragon'; = Aragón)
manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding · a las manos 'for the hands' (pidió agua a las manos 'asked for water to wash his hands'); bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', busy eating · also a las manos tomar 'to take by the hand' (a las manos les tomó, Pidal 'los tomó de la mano')
piden: pedir — they ask for (present 3rd pl.; ellos vos las piden 'they ask you for them'; = piden)
ge: ge — to him, to her, to them (old dative pronoun before lo, la, los, las, where modern Spanish has se; non ge los dieran en don 'they had not given them to him as a gift'; = se)
diessen: dar — they should give (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = diesen)
ondra: ondra — honor (= honra) · also ondra — a grant ondra 'with great honor' (adverbial phrase)
merced: merced — mercy, favor, grace (noun; Merced, Campeador 'mercy, thanks, Campeador', the word of a suppliant or of thanks; = merced)
me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
demandan: demandar — they ask (for), inquire (present 3rd pl.; demandar por 'to ask after'; = demandan)
casastes: casar — you married (off) (preterite 2nd pl., -stes ending, said to the king; Casastes sus fijas 'you married off his daughters'; = casasteis)
afé: afé — behold, here is (presentative particle, used before a noun; afé Dios del çielo 'behold God of heaven'; = he aquí; origin uncertain) · also before a que-clause 'behold, (it is so) that' (afé que me plaz 'behold, it pleases me')
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me') · also past part. 'ordered, charged' after aver (que a mí lo ovo mandado 'who had charged me with it'); with gelo he mandado 'I have promised it to him' (Pidal 'otorgado, o prometido') under 'granted'
nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)' · also nada — born (old participle, Latin nata, agreeing with mugier; non … fijo de mugier nada 'no son of woman born', no one at all, Pidal 'hijo de nadie', 'ninguno'; a reading of the grammar)
feré: fazer — I shall do (future 1st sg.; esto feré 'I shall do this'; = haré)
